title: Machine Learning Approaches for Early Prediction of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus Based on Prospective Cohort Study
summary: Machine-learning classifiers predicted gestational diabetes in a prospectively enrolled 2,811-pregnancy cohort. Models used a random internal split without external validation; prospective enrollment does not establish prospective testing of a locked model.
ai_technology: Machine-learning classifiers predict gestational diabetes from prospective pregnancy-cohort features.
organization: The Affiliated Hospital of Qingdao University

evidence.tested: The study reports machine-learning prediction of gestational diabetes from clinical pregnancy features in a prospective 2,811-pregnancy cohort, evaluated with a random internal split.
evidence.unknown: The model was evaluated on an internal random split without external validation or prospective testing of a locked model.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning classifiers predict gestational diabetes from prospective pregnancy-cohort features.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
